variants.name: stack OS threads (stackful, no colouring)
variants.implementation_notes: The stackful alternative with no colouring: an ordinary blocking function can block at any depth. The cost is a real stack per thread, which is why a thread-per-request is not scalable and tokio's async is preferred for I/O - but for CPU-bound work a thread pool with blocking code is correct and simpler.
pitfalls: A stack per thread; thousands of them exhaust memory.
The blocking code path is correct but not scalable for I/O.
